research_needed.question: How much of the M14 speed gain is the busway and how much is the SBS settling in?
research_needed.data: Segment speeds or AVL bus positions for 14th Street, April 2019 to February 2020.

notes: Weekday M14 speed was 5.502 mph in July to September 2019 and 5.817 mph in October 2019 to February 2020; other Manhattan routes averaged 5.895 and 5.889 mph. The M14 was already speeding up during the SBS-only summer (July 5.421, August 5.484, September 5.615 mph), so part of the estimate may be SBS improvement continuing; the design's placebo spread does not cover a route-specific trend of this kind. Route-wide speed dilutes the corridor gain, since each route runs well beyond 14th Street. Exploratory, ridership (MTA Bus Hourly Ridership, 98u6-vmgs and kv7t-n8in): weekday M14A+M14D boardings averaged 24826 in October 2018 to February 2019 and 29486 in October 2019 to February 2020 (+19%), which includes the SBS and the L train slowdown; July 2019, the month the SBS began, shows half the usual count and is likely incomplete.
notes_referee: Referee reproduced +5.46% (1.69 to 9.36); 2 of 119 placebos as large. The gain appeared in September 2019, before the busway; busway months +0.7% over September alone (exploratory). Much of the gain may be SBS and seasonal.
